about: Conformance vectors for the Maia animation score. Contract: docs/contracts/maia-score.md.
For each vector, makeParser(testFixtureVocabulary)(input) must deep-equal expected. A string input is passed as a string, anything else as a value.
testFixtureVocabulary is a test fixture, not the real vocabulary. Never ship it or use it to generate a score.
